ev.q: During 2012–2013, six confirmed Heartland virus disease cases were identified; five patients were Missouri residents, and one was a Tennessee resident.
Four of the patients were hospitalized. One patient with multiple comorbidities died.
Patients had symptom onset during May to September (three cases in May, one in July, and two in September).
All patients were men aged ≥50 years (median = 58 years; range = 50–80 years).
Six additional cases of Heartland virus disease were identified during 2012–2013; four of those patients were hospitalized.
